notes: 2003 four-storey police bureau, a rounded rectangle of dark red-brown brick with brown-framed windows on Linnaeusstraat / Kruislaan (the whole pand: 34.2 x 23.3 m, 19.7 m eaves, 3DBAG panels 3, 4, 1 and 0). Three fronts from panoramas: west (2025-09-26, w01-249): four rows, tall windows on the first floor and ground floor shutters; north (2019-05-23, w02-341, sun-flared): a dark door at the right end of the ground floor and gold POLITIE lettering high on the right on the second floor; south (2022-06-13, w03-161): a roller-shutter vehicle bay at the right end, a glazed entrance at the left under a street sign, and a blue diamond POLITIE blade sign at the left.

The east wall (panel 0, 34.2 m, bearing 71) has no panorama (candidates 0) and is INFERRED: the same brick grid as the west front, same bay rhythm, no components. A previous attempt left it blank and audit:glb failed on the 34 m blank wall.

Ornaments: POLITIE lettering in gold on the north wall (MODELLED, wall signage; the kit centres it over the entrance bay at the right, the photo has it one storey higher and left of the door: position deviation about 2.5 m); dark door at the north end (MODELLED, entrance); roller-shutter vehicle bay on the south (MODELLED, garageDoors 1); south glazed entrance with blue diamond blade sign (entrance MODELLED, blade SIMPLIFIED as the kit blue lamp: same colour and position by the entrance, a box not a diamond); blue sign on the west front's right edge (SKIPPED: the same police blade on the corner, a duplicate of the south one, not on the rectified crop); ground-floor roller shutters on the west front (SKIPPED: shutter slats are texture at 15 mm, the window reveal is kept); security cameras and the flagpole (SKIPPED: 0.2 m and slender fixtures, not stable between captures); no striped band, canopy or crest visible.
